description: This file defines a React component named SuggestionsPanel, which displays a list of suggestion items with associated icons, impact indicators, descriptions, and action buttons. It includes helper components for icons and a function to style impact labels.

methods.name: pillForImpact
methods.description: Returns a class string for styling impact labels based on 'low', 'medium', or 'high' impact levels.

methods.name: SunIcon
methods.description: Renders an SVG icon representing the sun.

methods.name: ZapIcon
methods.description: Renders an SVG icon representing a lightning bolt.

methods.name: ArrowUpRightIcon
methods.description: Renders an SVG icon depicting an arrow pointing up and to the right.

methods.name: SuggestionsPanel
methods.description: Main React component that displays a suggestions panel with conditional rendering based on whether suggestions are available.
